rule: Do not advance because checks passed. Stop at the truthful completion tier when final assets, Studio execution, performance measurements, or human evidence are unavailable.

phases.name: Bailiff Production Encounter
phases.reason: Bailiff production state, evidence intake, and encounter definitions exist in source, but final rig, animation, Studio route evidence, and human fairness validation are absent.

phases.name: Final Audible World
phases.reason: Audio hierarchy and cue captions exist, but licensed final files, Roblox IDs, actual playback, listening tests, and mix validation are absent.

phases.name: Production Environment Art
phases.reason: Environment memory layers exist as source proxy geometry; final models, materials, lighting, VFX, screenshots, and route composition evidence are absent.

phases.name: Exploration and Interaction
phases.reason: Secrets and prompt wiring exist, but finished rooms, physical interactions, shortcut animation, checkpoint persistence, and Studio route proof are absent.

phases.name: Puzzle Production
phases.reason: Puzzle hint tiers and recovery policy are represented in configuration, but production puzzle execution, human comprehension, and Studio validation are absent.

phases.name: Narrative and Cinematics
phases.reason: Narrative beats and state attributes exist, but authored scenes, executed cinematics, camera policy proof, and ending presentation evidence are absent.

phases.name: Horror Direction
phases.reason: Pacing segments are defined, but actual playthrough pacing, tension valleys, encounter spacing, and player response evidence are absent.

phases.name: Multiplayer Horror
phases.reason: Ownership rules exist, but two-player or four-player route execution, target-switch evidence, and anti-chaos validation are absent.

phases.name: Accessibility and UX
phases.reason: Cue equivalents and HUD state exist, but complete accessible route testing, controller/touch evidence, and no-audio playthrough proof are absent.

phases.name: Replayability
phases.reason: Replay variation definitions exist, but multiple complete varied playthroughs and ending consequence validation are absent.

phases.name: Performance and Stability
phases.reason: Budgets exist, but device measurements, soak testing, instance/connection growth tracking, and checkpoint recovery measurements are absent.

phases.name: Human Playtesting
phases.reason: Protocol exists, but no human testers, observation notes, comprehension results, defect remediation, or retest evidence were imported.

phases.name: Release Candidate
phases.reason: Release-candidate gates exist, but content lock, final assets, Studio route proof, human validation, performance evidence, and certification authority evidence are absent.
